name: Thai Crunch Salad with Peanut Dressing
notes: I may like this one better than above.

items: 2 Tbsp fresh lime juice (about one lime)
3 Tbsp vegetable oil (I skipped this and upped the lime, and it was great)
1-inch square piece of fresh ginger, grated
¼ tsp crushed red pepper flakes
4 cups chopped Napa cabbage or shredded coleslaw mix (add red cabbage for color)
1 red bell pepper, thinly sliced into bite-sized pieces
1 cup cooked and shelled edamame (or substitute chicken for protein)
1 small English cucumber, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced
½ cup loosely packed chopped fresh cilantro

steps.title: Make the dressing
steps.body: Blend or mix together for the dressing: **¼ cup peanut butter**, **2 Tbsp rice vinegar**, **2 Tbsp fresh lime juice** (about one lime), **3 Tbsp vegetable oil** (I skipped this and upped the lime, and it was great), **1 Tbsp soy sauce**, **2 Tbsp honey**, **2½ Tbsp sugar**, **2 garlic cloves**, minced, **1-inch square piece of fresh ginger**, grated, **1 tsp salt**, **¼ tsp crushed red pepper flakes** and **2 Tbsp fresh cilantro leaves**.

steps.title: Assemble the salad
steps.body: Assemble salad: **4 cups chopped Napa cabbage** or shredded coleslaw mix (add red cabbage for color), **1 cup shredded carrots**, **1 red bell pepper**, thinly sliced into bite-sized pieces, **1 cup cooked and shelled edamame** (or substitute chicken for protein), **2 medium green onions**, sliced fine, **1 small English cucumber**, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced, and **½ cup loosely packed chopped fresh cilantro**.

steps.title: Dress and serve
steps.body: Top the salad with dressing and add chopped peanuts as desired.
